obfuscation_indicators: not easily defined on our balance sheet
risk_summary: The excerpt provides useful quantified operating and liquidity data but discloses substantial going-concern risk, recurring losses, low cash, working-capital deficits, and reliance on related-party and new debt financing. Management offsets these concerns with broad growth, synergy, and technology-asset claims that are only partly quantified and include significant forward-looking caveats. High financing costs, operational cash-flow pressure, and potential OTC market delisting create material credit and liquidity risks.
